a 1 EXT. SAN JOAQUIN VALLEY, CA - DAY .
A dirt road snakes between barbed-wire fences and grassy
Pasture. It is early morning, an idyllic rural dawn. CAMERA
CRANES DOWN as a flat-bed TRUCK rumbles into frame. Approaching:
A MIGRANT CAMP
A sad collection of corrugated tin shanties. Nearby, about two-
dozen MIGRANTS huddle near the road. A LEGEND identifies:
MIGRANT WORKERS CAMP, SAN JOAQUIN VALLEY, CA.
As the truck pulls to a stop, the migrants rush forward, calling
out in Spanish. A white FOREMAN stands on the flatbed, choosing
who gets to work today with a point of his finger.
ANGLE ON ELADIO BUENTE (20s)
A handsome illegal, standing under a tall, broad tree. Unlike
the others, he DOESN'T run to vie for work. Leaning against the
tree as if in wait. His eyes on:
MARIA DORANTES (19)
A pretty Hispanic girl, who herds several goats toward a rusty
pen nearby. She gets a peck kiss on the cheek from SOLEDAD
& BUENTE (30s), who we'll learn is Eladio's brother. Before
Soledad runs off to join the men competing for work at the
truck. As Soledad hurries off, Maria turns and looks at:
